# Reservation Functions

Maintains booking groups and replay-safe operational decisions on an Order. Initialization reads the configured snapshot and can check the customer's admitted account. Proposal actions validate keys, exact proposal review and caller intent, then record status and configured deadlines.

Exact-version confirmation, alternative and acceptance record the booking and can emit the typed `Schedule/Reservation Reviewed` event. The event identifies the mounted clause, group, role channel, exact proposal, proposal amount in minor units, saved group record and signed operation request. A consumer such as Activation can choose that source. Reservation owns the booking decision, and Activation owns any separately configured approval of terms.

A caller can project the one whole-Order group's ID, status and confirmed start using `publishWholeOrderReservation`. The functions record operational cancellation, no-show, decline and expiry under their state and time guards. A commercial fee comes from the configured cancellation policy.
